title: Kling Image 4.0
description: Kling Image 4.0 — Kling's newest image model: realistic images with correctly spelled text, and edits that combine up to 10 reference images (refer to them in the prompt as @image_1, @image_2 …). 2K or 4K output in 8 aspect ratios or auto. Billing: 75 credits per image at 2K, 115 at 4K, plus 4 per reference image (each one, per generated image). No seed or negative prompt.
pricing_text: Pricing: 75 credits per generation (varies by resolution).

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. "auto" (default) lets the model choose (an edit usually keeps its input's shape).

num_images.description: Number of images to generate (each one is billed).

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate, or of the edit to make with the reference images; refer to them in order as @image_1, @image_2 …. Write `@handle` to cast a character: a BudgetPixel AI influencer or one of your own ([`GET /v1/characters`](/api-reference/characters/list-characters-you-can-cast)).

reference_images.description: Optional reference images (up to 10) to edit or combine. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-image. Each reference image bills 4 credits per generated image. An image under 300 px on a side is scaled up; its shape must be between 2:5 and 5:2.

size.description: Output size: 2K is about 4 MP (2048x2048, or 2496x1664 at 3:2) and bills 75 credits per image; 4K is about 16 MP (5440x3072 at 16:9) and bills 115. Reference images add 4 each.
